title: Calculation Sheet: Overdue Renewal Amount on Web Hosting Plans
content:
**Calculation sheet — Web Hosting Plans overdue renewal amount**

**A. Regular price.** The overdue renewal amount is the plan tier's regular price for the new term length: the tier's regular 12, 24 or 36-month rate (from the Web Hosting Plans price schedule) multiplied by the months of that term, or the tier's 1-month price for a 1-month term, with no setup fee.

**B. New term length.** The new term length is the current one (the plan's billing term) unless a scheduled term change applies: a term change request in status scheduled sets the new term length to its target term in months (the latest submitted one when there are several; withdrawn, declined and applied requests never count).

**C. Rounding.** The overdue renewal amount is rounded half up to the cent.

**D. Assembly.** Credits and fees are fixed amounts in USD that are never discounted: the overdue renewal amount is the discounted price less the credits plus any fee, rounded half up to the cent, and the credits together never take more than half of the discounted price. The discounted price is the regular price after the percentage that acts on it, if any, has acted once, rounded half up to the cent before any credit or fee is applied.

**Worked example (hypothetical rate, requests and amounts — not Harborline prices).**

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Plan's billing term | 24 months |
| Term change requests | one to 36 months, withdrawn; one to 12 months, scheduled |
| Tier's regular 12-month rate (hypothetical) | USD 7.45 per month |

The withdrawn request never counts, so the scheduled request sets the new term at 12 months. Regular price: 7.45 multiplied by 12 is USD 89.40. With no credit and no fee the overdue renewal amount is USD 89.40.

**Assembly illustration (hypothetical credits and fee).** On a discounted price of USD 89.40, credits of USD 6.35 and a fee of USD 2.20 give USD 85.25. Credits of USD 50.00 would be held to half of USD 89.40, that is USD 44.70, giving USD 46.90 with the same fee.
